profile.headline: Digital Accessibility SME @ Walmart, IAAP CPWA
profile.summary:
Nhi Nguyen is an accessibility advocate driven by inclusive design and digital accessibility. She is a digital accessibility specialist who is skilled at Accessibility auditing and testing (Web, mobile apps, etc.), accessibility trainings, and strategic planning. 

Nhi has experiences leading accessibility teams, working with and providing consultancy for Fortune top 500 companies and multinational tech giants. Acknowledged for being a hardworking team player who can manage diverse teams effectively. 

Nhi Nguyen is a certified professional in Digital Accessibility with IAAP CPWA Certified. Nhi usually volunteers with local non-profit organizations such as Habitat for Humanity or Be My Eyes. Nhi enjoys giving talks and presentations to students about Accessibility to empower them on their journey to make every digital platform accessible for everyone. 

Outside of work, Nhi's hobbies include taking care of her houseplants, visiting national parks, and backpacking.

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Accessibility Testing, End-to-End
positions.description:
• Acts as Sprint Lead and leads Walmart E2E (End-to-End) Accessibility Testing Team on manual accessibility testing for Walmart websites and apps. 
• Standardizes and implements Accessibility Testing Process for E2E ADA A11y Testing Team.
• Coaches and provides guidance to team members to enhance A11y technical skills and improve workflow efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Accessibility Testing, End-to-End
positions.description:
• Acted as A11y SME representative when interacting with Product Teams, Design Teams, and venfors.
• Initiated and published ADA Scope and Testing Estimation documentation, resulting in 50% increase in timeline and scope accuracy.
• Awarded October 2022 Employee of the Month under GEC-CE org for stellar performance and contribution.

positions.title: Senior Accessibility Analyst
positions.description:
• Acted as Primary Tester for big enterprise client testing and auditing projects and provide mentorship to new employees.
• Owned and authored several high-quality deliver calls, AMP Reports, and VPATs to customers.  
• Created delivery deck and conveys complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Recognized as a nominee for Specialized Delivery Team's President's Club Award. 
• Received February 2022 Leveler Award for developing detailed guide and instructional videos for new team members to onboard a complex customized process for big healthcare client that resulted in increased efficiency and shortened testing time.

positions.title: Accessibility Analyst
positions.description:
• Worked with clients to test and validate user interfaces against accessibility standards such as WCAG and Section 508.
• Initiated and authored new auditing process for a big enterprise client, resulting in 50% efficiency increase. 
• Provided realistic technical guidance to clients that can be integrated into current or new systems.
• Utilized accessibility tools (ZoomText, CCA, etc.) and assistive technology (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack) to perform manual testing.
• Received October 2021 Leveler Award for exceptional auditing, client management, and communication skills

positions.title: Fox Peer Instructor - MIS 3502: Application Integration and Evaluation
positions.description:
• Led exam review sessions and assist students with AWS, MySQL and JavaScript assignments.
• Peer taught 70+ students, coach 2 Teaching Assistants, and coordinated helpdesk hours to provide academic support.

About the course MIS 3502 - Application Integration and Evaluation: Use concepts of application integration to develop data driven software applications. Design the system architecture for an n-tier application. Learn how to integrate existing applications to produce new capabilities. Identify the technical and process issues of integrating a new application into the existing application structure.

positions.title: Information Technology Assistant - MIS 0855: Data Science
positions.description:
• Assisted students with in-class exercises and Tableau assignments.
• Conducted exam reviews, including Tableau Workshops and Data Visualization Techniques (Piktochart).
• Held office hours to support students with any question regarding to the course.

MIS 0855 - Data Science: This course teaches students how to harness the power of data by mastering the ways it is stored, organized, and analyzed to enable better decisions. Students get hands-on experience by solving problems using a variety of powerful, computer-based data tools virtually every organization uses.

positions.title: Information Technology Assistant - MIS 2402: Data Centric Application
positions.description:
• Assisted 100+ students with questions regarding to Visual Studio Code text editor, FileZilla, and programming languages (HTML,CSS,JavaScript) 
• Held office hour and individual workshops outside of class 
MIS 2402 -  Data-Centric Application Development: Students get hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Bootstrap. The course teaches students to use debugging techniques to identify errors, provides methods to interpret system requirement specifications, and explains technical components including the use of systems development lifecycles in creating software applications.

positions.title: Director Of Information Technology
positions.description:
• Monitored, implemented, and developed Temple AIS website: www.temple-ais.org 
• Updated and managed Temple AIS Emailing Listserv
• Brainstormed topics, plan, and led monthly two-hour Technical Development workshops.
• Generated a database of potential Student Leaders and Student Assistants for workshops.
--------------------------
Spring 2020 Technical Development Workshop: 
• April 2020 Workshop: Website Accessibility Practices
• March 2020 Workshop: Data Visualization with Python libraries (part 2)
• February 2020 Workshop: Data Visualization with Python libraries (part 1)

Fall 2019 Technical Development Workshops: 
• November 2019 Workshop: Getting started with Git and GitHub
• October 2019 Workshop: Text Analytics with Python 
• September 2019 Workshop: Database Management with PostgreSQL

company.name: Temple Education Abroad and Overseas Campuses

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Analyzed and restructured an 18-year-old database with 15,000+ records on study abroad programs and student demographics. 
• Independently designed and created the tracking performance metrics and input data templates.
• Developed data warehouse design and modeling according to established standards.
• Utilized PostgreSQL, Tableau, Access and other visualization tool sets for data intelligence and analysis.

positions.title: Study Abroad Peer Advisor
positions.description:
• Promoted international education and lead information sessions
• Advised and assisted students studying abroad with program selection, application procedures, and opportunities
• Developed promotional materials and assisted other outreach efforts, including special events and classroom visits
• Assisted with daily office activities such as answering phones and emails, maintaining contact and event databases, and general office duties

positions.title: Student Vlogger
positions.description:
I applied to be a Student Vlogger for Temple Study Abroad Department and got accepted due to my unique background. I am the only international student at Temple University who decided to step outside the comfort zone and participated in a two-month summer abroad program in Dublin, Ireland. I want to redefine the definition "study abroad" for international student and raise the awareness of endless opportunities that international student body can take advantage of. 

• Worked as an influencer and encourage international students to study abroad
• Provided a unique perspective of an Asian student in a European country 
• Assisted students with questions relating to study abroad and cultural adjustment

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Assisted Lead Web Developer with a three-month site migration process, resulting in a stable, multidev environment with version control, updated WordPress, plugins, and PHP 7.2.
• Executed and monitored standards for user interfaces, page design, and graphics development of Temple Fox website.

company.name: Fox School of Business at Temple University

positions.title: Software Project Management Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted Chief Technology Officer in managing 9+ software development projects with client contract values worth over $500,000.
• Managed four projects simultaneously, conducted interviews with SMEs and sponsors, created detailed documentations on Work Breakdown Structure and Management Plans. 
• Defined project plan and created SOWs and functional specifications.
• Responsible for ensuring developers met all milestones and goals as laid out in project plan. 

Tools and Resources: GitHub, JIRA,Developer Tools, TestQuality, Teamwork

positions.title: Advisor
positions.description:
➡ Achievements: 
• Successfully organized the 2nd annual Women In Consulting event with more than 150+ participants. 
• Assisted Senior Associate with the new event: Business Etiquette Dinner. 
• Mentored Temple Consulting Club's Eboard members on strategic planning, organization communications, and membership retainment.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
➡ Achievements: 
• Successfully formalized Temple Consulting Club (TCC) as an affiliated Student Professional Organization (SPO)
• Led a diverse team of 7 undergraduates and 5 graduates 
• Increased number of paid members by 35 percent

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
➡ Achievements: 
• Founded the inaugural Women In Consulting event with 100+ participants. Guest speakers were four female leaders and experts in the industry
• Got interviewed in Fox School News
• Raised average attendance of general meetings by 20 percent 
• Doubled number of officers for Leadership Team

positions.title: Consulting Program Associate
positions.description:
•	Facilitated connections between key leaders throughout the university and the Academic Director.
•	Planned and executed vehicles for maximizing engagement with the student population.
•	Developed a strategy for the deployment and ongoing management of social media platforms.
•	Managed dashboard for social media activity for Temple Consulting Club and presented monthly reports of social media accomplishments.

positions.title: Business Development Executive - ICT Tech Transfer Intern
positions.description:
• Pitched entry strategy to Irish wearable technology start-up company seeking to capture the international market. 
• Recommended proposals on products pricing, customer segmentation, and route-to market business plan.
• Utilized Zoho CRM to design digital funnels, created metrics for conversion rate, and generated 50 sale leads. 
• Presented "Technology Capsules" to prospective clients to drive leads and sales.

company.name: NovaUCD - The Hub of Commercialisation and Entrepreneurship Activity at University College Dublin

positions.title: Business Development Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with 18 Chambers of Commerce to promote JMEC information sessions, lectures, and networking events. 
• Planned and executed the annual June Awards Ceremony banquet for 200 participants. 
• Developed spreadsheet tool to track participants, clients, and attendance information. 
• Analyzed, updated statistical database, and conducted JMEC participant annual reports.
